la:verb:vibro.html:
vī^bro, āvi, ātum, 1, v. a. and n.
cf. Sanscr. vip, to tremble
.
Act., to set in tremulous motion, to move rapidly to and fro, to brandish, shake, agitate (class.; syn.: quatio, ventilo).
Lit.: hastas ante pugnam,: hastam,: flamina vestes,to cause to flutter,: faces,: multifidas linguas (draco),: tremor vibrat ossa,makes tremble,: viscera vibrantur (equitando),are shaken about,: impositus scuto more gentis et sustinentium umeris vibratus, dux eligitur,: digitis vibratis jactare sententias,: thyrsum manu,: serpens squalidum crista caput vibrans,.—Poet.: vibrata flammis aequora,i. e. glimmering, sparkling,: crines vibrati,i. e. curled, frizzled,; .— Mid.: sic mea vibrari pallentia membra videres,.—
Transf., to throw with a vibratory motion, to launch, hurl: sicas et spargere venena,: conferti et quasi cohaerentes tela vibrare non poterant,: tremulum excusso jaculum lacerto,: per auras spicula,: fulmina (Juppiter),; cf.: vibratus ab aethere fulgor,: jaculum ex arborum ramis vibrari,. —
Trop.
Of language, to fling, hurl, launch: truces vibrare iambos,; cf. 2. vibratus, II.—
To threaten: tela undique mortem vibrantia,. —
Neutr., to be in tremulous motion, etc.
Lit.
In gen., to shake, quiver, vibrate, tremble: linguā vibrante (serpentis),; : terrae motus non simplici modo quatitur, sed tremit vibratque,.—
Of the voice or sounds, to tremble: (haec vox) sonat adhuc et vibrat in auribus meis,; cf.: sonus lusciniae vibrans,: querelā adhuc vibrante,: ejusmodi fabulae vibrabant,.—
To glimmer, glitter, gleam, scintillate, etc.: mare, quā a sole collucet, albescit et vibrat,: signa, : in tremulo vibrant incendia ponto,; ; ; .—Of bright weapons: juvenes Tela tenent dextrā lato vibrantia ferro,: gladius,; cf.: clipeum Vibranti medium cuspis transverberat ictu,.—
Trop., of language: cujus (Demosthenis) non tam vibrarent fulmina illa, nisi numeris contorta ferrentur,would not have been hurled with such vigor,; cf.: oratio incitata et vibrans,: sententiae,; . —Hence, vĭbrātus, a, um, P. a., impetuous, forcible: iambus flammis fulminis vibratior,.
